name: Press start
description: A tile-built gold star with a hard red shadow sits on a navy title card above a two-line menu and a blinking cursor: the rating you give, as a cartridge title screen.
choices: An 8-bit title-screen layout: one backdrop, chunky tile-aligned pixels, a hard drop shadow and a two-entry menu
Palette cycling makes the star’s centre shimmer without moving a pixel; no lettering is placed in the symbol
motion: The star’s centre cycles through three palette entries and the menu cursor blinks.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
